DM: Sailing up the broad stretch of the Chasa river to the vibrant, bustling port of Chardon. The city stretches for miles along the south bank of a river with smaller outposts on the north on the shoulders of Mount Nera, whose dark slopes loom over the city. South of the river, the city gleams with the dazzling colors of hundreds, what seems sometimes like thousands of towers. Some the muted colors of natural stone: gray, white, black, but others shine like the setting sun or blaze with the violet of a field of flowers or the bright gold of the sun in the middle of the day, or even swirl with patterns of stars or waves. And all of these towers are dominated—looming over all of them—is the twisting spire the Great Library itself reaching 600 feet in the sky, to the east, and the huge imposing facade of the Imperial Palace, to the west, with the great octagonal dome of the Cathedral of the Way between these landmarks.

The north bank, this time in the afternoon is partially hidden by a low fog that hangs on the slopes of Mount Nera and carries a faint acrid stench over the water when the winds briefly shift.

The two sides of the city are separated by a great arching bridge wide enough for four carts to pass abreast and enchanted to rise from its anchors to allow ships with tall masts past. As you sail under the bridge the noise from above briefly pauses as the central part of the stone arch creaks and then raises into the sky, to allow your masts to clear the span. And as the bridge settles back into place behind you, you can see the river widen ahead, the busy wharves of the port come into view. Dozens upon dozens of ships of all sizes shapes and colors fill the harbor, some loading or unloading on the docks others that anchorage.

As you as the Emerald Song slides into a berth in what seems to be the halfling section of the wharves and you look out across the vastness city you do get your one hint from your DM, but you are not totally without contacts or information, so you have Kaeso, Kenzo's former mentor who lives in the south of the city in the Panemsgate neighborhood near the Kylos Market which Kenzo knows the way to.

The name Crispus was mentioned to you by Marcella as the person who is the senior archivist at the Great Library and supposedly a major patron and sponsor of treasure hunting. Sorry, I just saw your message. You, of course, know Vola the adventurer and explorer you rescued at Raven's Hold who must have presumably, return to Chardon by now.
